x-card.description: Indexes and documents of Meilisearch and Meilisearch Cloud: full-text search with filters, facets and sorting. Document writes and deletes wait for approval.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Meilisearch's address with https:// (and its port, 7700 for a server of your own), optionally with a path prefix. Plain http:// only to this computer.

indexes.title: Indexes
indexes.description: The indexes agents may use; * matches any characters, such as products_*. Empty: every index the credentials see.

method.title: Authentication
method.description: No authentication only for a server that checks no key, never on prod.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Prefer the Default Search API Key, or a key with search and documents.get only, unless agents should write.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: A private CA. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate comes from a private CA.
